questionEnglish: What should you check before starting a long journey?
questionSomali: Maxaad hubinaysaa ka hor safar dheer?
explanationSomali: Darawalku waa inuu hubiyaa taayirrada, saliidda iyo nalalka si gaarigu u noqdo mid ammaan ah.

questionEnglish: Is using a handheld mobile phone while driving allowed?
questionSomali: Ma la oggol yahay isticmaalka telefoon gacanta lagu hayo marka la wado?
optionsSomali: Haa, haddii si tartiib ah loo wado
Haa, marka nalka taraafikada la joogo
explanationSomali: Isticmaalka telefoon gacanta lagu hayo marka la wado waa khatar, wuxuuna yareeyaa feejignaanta darawalka.

questionEnglish: What should you do in heavy rain?
questionSomali: Maxaad sameynaysaa marka roob culus jiro?
explanationSomali: Roobka culus wuxuu yareeyaa aragtida iyo qabsashada waddada, sidaas darteed waa in xawaaraha la yareeyaa.

questionEnglish: Why should drivers check mirrors before changing lanes?
questionSomali: Maxay muhiim u tahay in muraayadaha la hubiyo ka hor inta aan lane la beddelin?
explanationSomali: Hubinta muraayadaha waxay kaa caawisaa inaad aragto gaadiidka ama dadka ku jira meelaha qarsoon.

questionEnglish: What should drivers do near pedestrians?
questionSomali: Maxay tahay in darawalku sameeyo marka dadka lugaynaya ag dhow yihiin?
optionsSomali: Horn-ka si joogto ah u isticmaal
explanationSomali: Darawalku waa inuu xawaaraha yareeyaa oo diyaar u noqdaa inuu istaago marka dadka lugaynaya ag dhow yihiin.

questionEnglish: Who must wear seatbelts in a car?
questionSomali: Yaa qasab ku ah inuu xirto suunka badbaadada gaariga dhexdiisa?
explanationSomali: Dhammaan dadka gaariga saaran waa inay xirtaan suunka badbaadada si loo yareeyo dhaawaca shilalka.

questionEnglish: What should you do near a school zone?
questionSomali: Maxaad sameynaysaa marka aad ku dhowdahay school zone?
explanationSomali: School zone waa meel carruur badan joogaan, sidaas darteed darawalku waa inuu si taxaddar leh u wadaa.

questionEnglish: What does a red octagon sign mean?
questionSomali: Maxay ka dhigan tahay calaamad cas oo octagon ah?
explanationSomali: Calaamadda cas ee octagon-ka ah waxay ka dhigan tahay STOP, waana in darawalku si buuxda u istaagaa.

questionEnglish: What does a triangular warning sign indicate?
questionSomali: Maxay tilmaamaysaa calaamad saddex xagal ah?
explanationSomali: Calaamadaha saddex xagalka ah waxay digniin ka bixiyaan khatar ama xaalad waddo oo hore jirta.

questionEnglish: What does a blue circular sign usually mean?
questionSomali: Maxay badanaa ka dhigan tahay calaamad buluug ah oo wareegsan?
explanationSomali: Calaamadaha buluugga ah ee wareegsan waxay badanaa bixiyaan amar qasab ah oo darawalku raaco.

questionEnglish: What does a no entry sign mean?
questionSomali: Maxay ka dhigan tahay calaamadda no entry?
explanationSomali: Calaamadda no entry waxay ka dhigan tahay in gaadiidku uusan geli karin waddadaas.
